data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: Toolbox Controls • Containers & Display: - Form: Main window and control container. - Label: Displays read-only text. - PictureBox: Displays images and icons. • Input & Action: - TextBox: Field for user text entry. - Button: Triggers an action when clicked. - DateTimePicker: Dropdown calendar picker. • Selections & Indicators: - ListBox / ComboBox: Lists & dropdown menus. - RadioButton / CheckBox: Single vs multi-choice. - ProgressBar / ScrollBar: Value & progress trackers.
